action6_effect: No effect observed: ACTION6 with no data and ACTION6 with data {"x": 14, "y": 30} each changed zero rendered pixels, moved no player or block, and did not decrement the timer.
narrative: I replayed the known 33-action prefix and reached levels_completed=1, then probed only through env.step results and rendered grids. For multi-carry, I picked up the outlined block at (12,8), whose rendered outline changed from color 4 to carried color 5, and transported it beside the separate outlined block at (4,7). Issuing ACTION5 while the first block was still carried never produced two carried blocks: the immediate returned frame still showed only the first carried block and left the second outlined, and the following rendered transition showed the first block dropped at (4,8) while the second remained outlined at (4,7). ACTION6 was accepted both without data and with a click at display coordinate (14,30), the center of bay cell (3,7), but both calls had exactly zero grid delta and no timer, player, block, or level effect. For diagonal movement, I steered the rendered direction indicator to the diagonal corner (6,0); across the resulting movement frames the player advanced only (8,8)->(9,8)->(10,8), one cardinal cell per timer tick, never changing both coordinates in one tick. Thus neither probe reduces movement cost, so v5's optimistic 80-movement lower bound still exceeds the 64-cell timer and was not recomputed under an unchanged model. I stopped at levels_completed=1 without forcing a timer reset or attempting an infeasible solve.
